LESSON: VIRTUES: KINDNESS TO ALLAH’S CREATURES

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1.1: Virtues: Kindness to Allah’s Creatures

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Virtues: Kindness to Allah’s Creatures
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are some of Allah’s creatures in your environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. demonstrate ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures as an act of ibadah
2. appreciate Allah’s creatures by being kind to them

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: demonstrate ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures as an act of ibadah

Teach
• Today’s focus: demonstrate ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures as an act of ibadah.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “demonstrate ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures as an act of ibadah” using a school example.
• Model B for “demonstrate ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures as an act of ibadah” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "demonstrate ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures as an act of ibadah" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate Allah’s creatures by being kind to them

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate Allah’s creatures by being kind to them.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate Allah’s creatures by being kind to them” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate Allah’s creatures by being kind to them” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate Allah’s creatures by being kind to them" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: demonstrate ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures as an act of ibadah
• Model 2: appreciate Allah’s creatures by being kind to them

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: demonstrate ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures as an act of ibadah
2. Practise: appreciate Allah’s creatures by being kind to them

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Virtues: Kindness to Allah’s Creatures.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are some of Allah’s creatures in your environment?
2. Why should you be kind to Allah’s creatures?
3. How can you be kind to Allah’s creatures?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• demonstrate ways of showing kindness to Allah’s creatures as an act of ibadah
• appreciate Allah’s creatures by being kind to them

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
